'''Mumbai Nashik Expressway''' (mr:मुंबई नाशिक द्रुतगती मार्ग) is a {{convert|150|km|abbr=on}}<ref name="nashikcity1">{{cite web |url=http://www.nashikcity.in/2009/mum-nashik-expressway-gets-boost-from-msrdc/ |title=Mum-Nashik Expressway gets boost from MSRDC | Nashik ::::: A Complete Guide and Update on Nashik |publisher=Nashikcity.in |date=29 January 2009 |access-date=2010-07-16 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110225104512/http://www.nashikcity.in/2009/mum-nashik-expressway-gets-boost-from-msrdc/ |archive-date=25 February 2011 }}</ref> long highway connecting [[Mumbai]] to [[Nashik]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gammoninfra.com/mnel.html |title=Projects – Mumbai Nasik Expressway Limited (MNEL) |publisher=Gammoninfra.com |access-date=2010-07-16}}</ref> The total cost of the project is {{INRConvert|40|b}}.<ref name="nashikcity1"/> At the time when this project was awarded, it was the largest BOT road project in India. The project involves increasing the number of lanes on the 99.5 km Vadape-Gonde (Mumbai-Nasik) section of the National Highway-3 to four.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.indiantollways.com/category/chennai/ |title=Chennai |publisher=Indian Tollways |access-date=2010-07-16}}</ref>

==Project development==
Projects under implementation in NHDP Phase III A 
;Vadpe to Gonde :
Vadpe is in [[Thane district]] and Gonde in [[Nashik district]]. 100 km work has been completed.
This contract was given in June 2005 to [[Gammon India]] + [[Sadbhav Engineering Limited]] + Billimoria consortium of contractors. The name of SPV is "Mumbai Nashik Expressway limited" The project cost was ₹5.79 billion. The expected completion date was 36 months from date of award of contract. The completion date was first extended up to April 2009. Now the completion date has been extended up to January 2011. The project supervision consultant to this project are Sheladia Associates INC- Artefact Projects Ltd – USA

As of 15 Jan 2018, this project has been completed up to 99%.<ref>{{cite web|author=Parag Parikh |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/mumbai-nashik-proj-is-key-toll-revenue-maker-gammon-infra_566378.html |title=Mumbai-Nashik proj is key toll revenue maker: Gammon Infra – CNBC-TV18 |publisher=Moneycontrol.com |access-date=2011-07-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nashikcity.in/2010/the-mumbai-nasik-expressway-is-expected-to-be-commissioned-before-march-2011/ |title=The Mumbai-Nasik Expressway is expected to be commissioned before March 2011 | Nashik ::::: A Complete Guide and Update on Nashik |publisher=Nashikcity.in |date=13 September 2010 |access-date=2011-07-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120325130222/http://www.nashikcity.in/2010/the-mumbai-nasik-expressway-is-expected-to-be-commissioned-before-march-2011/ |archive-date=25 March 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

extract: Mumbai Nashik Expressway (mr:मुंबई नाशिक द्रुतगती मार्ग) is a 150 km (93 mi) long highway connecting Mumbai to Nashik. The total cost of the project is ₹40 billion (US$420 million). At the time when this project was awarded, it was the largest BOT road project in India. The project involves increasing the number of lanes on the 99.5 km Vadape-Gonde (Mumbai-Nasik) section of the National Highway-3 to four.
